Instruct: Given a search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query

attributes.dataHandling: Text is sent to OpenRouter and served only by DeepInfra (US), with fallbacks off.
attributes.notes: OpenRouter publishes no weights revision; the revision is the date the space was fixed (pending confirmation). Calls pin the host: provider { only: ['deepinfra/us'], allow_fallbacks: false }. The standard text space (StandardTextVector) is this vectorizer at 1024 dimensions. Chosen 2026-11-05 by a 150-query benchmark: nDCG@10 0.603 (Cohere Embed 5 Pro 0.640, Qwen3 0.6B 0.548, Titan V2 0.498).
